_purpose: Machine-readable companion to docs/EQUATIONS_FOR_AI.md and floodconnect_model.py -- for a sandbox AI that wants the equations, variables, units, Toledo status and thresholds as data rather than prose. Toledo-first: re-check status at the toledo repository before citing, a proposal can be revised or merged after this file was written.
generated_from: toledo repository, branches proposals/flood-readout-trend (merged, PR #59), proposals/flood-water-balance (PR #60 OPEN), proposals/flood-outlet-coping (PR #63 OPEN)

equations.name: Lag-k retained difference with resolution-sign readout (Δk, rise/fall trend)
equations.toledo_status: registered Toledo proposal (unverified), not yet promoted to CANONICAL.json -- usable as a proposal-tier readout, never cited as a settled Toledo theorem

classification.NO_READOUT: t < k, or h(t-k) was not sampled -- a real distinct outcome, never silently FLAT

variables.source: official gauge page (e.g. thaiwater.net, a BMA canal-level page) or the caller's own reading at the same station

variables.meaning: reading k ticks earlier, same station

variables.unit: ticks (caller states what one tick is, e.g. 1 reading or 1 hour)
variables.source: declared BEFORE computing, never chosen after seeing the result

variables.meaning: the station's own declared sensor resolution
variables.source: the source's own stated resolution; if the source states none, epsilon is INSTINCT (a judgment call), never MEASURED

worked_example.station: WL.SSB.08 (c.แสนแสบ-เสรีไทย 24)
worked_example.note: a readout of the difference between two already-observed readings -- not a prediction that the water will keep rising at this rate

equations.name: Time-to-threshold by linear extension of the last retained difference, with refusal (Tk)
equations.toledo_status: same unverified-proposal status as PROP-FLOOD-01, shares its Toledo PR (#59, merged proposal)
equations.formula_ascii: T_k := (theta - h(t)) * k / delta_k(t)  [ticks], defined only when delta_k(t) > epsilon and h(t) < theta

refusal.REFUSED/UNRESOLVED: |delta_k(t)| <= epsilon (can't tell if it's really moving)
refusal.REFUSED/NOT_APPLICABLE: delta_k(t) < -epsilon, or h(t) >= theta, or delta_k(t) was NO_READOUT

variables.meaning: an official agency threshold (e.g. BMA's critical level for that station)
variables.source: the station's own declared warning/critical/bank value -- never a number the caller picks themselves

worked_example.note: report as an interval across at least two lags (e.g. k=1h and k=3h), never as one single point number; REFUSED is a non-value, not a number -- never print 0, infinity, or blank

equations.name: Water balance / water debt
equations.toledo_status: OPEN pull request, NOT merged -- strictly earlier stage than PROP-FLOOD-01/02's registered proposal; do not compute with this as if it were usable
equations.formula_ascii: S(k+1) = S(k) + rain_in - outflow  (for a declared basin)
equations.refusal: explicit REFUSED (never a silent zero or clamp) whenever a required input is missing, stale, or the result would be a bookkeeping-impossible negative storage
equations.note: water_balance.py in this repository returns REFUSED today for every area -- see docs/EQUATIONS_FOR_AI.md section 3 and AI_TIERS.md

equations.name: Outlet-coping tier (L0-L5)
equations.formula_ascii: ratio of forecast inflow to the smaller of outlet headroom or pump drainage capacity, banded into a 5-level tier (L0-L5)
equations.refusal: REFUSED when the unit/tuple isn't fully declared

equations.name: Flow-state classifier (F1-F6)
equations.formula_ascii: companion classification of flow direction/state built on the same inputs as PROP-FLOOD-03

classify_station_status._purpose: the non-numeric companion classifier -- maps an agency-declared station-status word onto the closed GREEN/YELLOW/RED/UNKNOWN vocabulary this repository's kb.py actually uses in production (community_dag.py's CURRENT_LOCAL_STATE); copied from readout.py's CRITICAL_LIKE_STATUS/FLOOD_LIKE_STATUS/NORMAL_LIKE_STATUS, not a Toledo-registered equation itself (no number is computed, it is a status-word lookup)
classify_station_status.UNKNOWN: no reading, an unrecognised word, or (in kb.py's fuller version, not reproduced in floodconnect_model.py) a sensor-fault word
classify_station_status.founder_ruling: 2026-10-04, verbatim 'WATCH = YELLOW (แนะนำ)' -- a bare WATCH reading alone no longer drives RED; RED is reserved for an agency-declared critical/overflow reading

one_decision._purpose: the six-step by-hand procedure from docs/EQUATIONS_FOR_AI.md section 5, steps 3-6, as a function
one_decision.vocabulary: Jev-style decision terms (see ARCHITECTURE.md §5): decision, confidence (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW/NONE), level (RED/YELLOW/GREEN/UNKNOWN), checks (list of str), gate (LICENSED_WITHIN_ENVELOPE/REFUSED), why
one_decision.BOT_not_zero: a missing h_t, a missing epsilon, or a stale reading produces gate=REFUSED and confidence=NONE, never a silent 0/GREEN

indicators._purpose: Closed dictionary of every flood indicator this repository (or its by-hand companion floodconnect_model.py) names -- full prose, worked examples and the bilingual (EN+Thai) one-line meanings live in docs/INDICATORS.md; this array is the same names/levels/status as data, mirrored verbatim into system_capabilities.json's own 'indicators' field (tests/test_floodconnect_model.py checks the two match). Founder ruling 2026-10-04, verbatim: 'ที่สำคัญคือให้ ตัวชี้วัดนี้น้ำน้ำท่วมต้องชัด' -- the flood indicators must be crystal clear.

color_contract._purpose: RED/YELLOW/GREEN/UNKNOWN is NOT a universal rule over every indicator below -- fix (2026-10-04, review finding #3): it applies ONLY to the two fields named here. Every other indicator has its own closed 'levels' list on its own entry below; read that entry's 'levels', never assume RED/YELLOW/GREEN/UNKNOWN.
